senses.gloss: ज्ञ (I) a. (f. ज्ञा) (at the end of compounds) Knowing, familiar with, R.i.92, M.iv.102.
ज्ञ (II) m. 1. A wise and learned man, a paṇḍit; 2. the sentient soul; 3. the planet Mercury; 4. the planet Mars; 5. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
ज्ञ (I) a. (f. ज्ञा) (at the end of compounds) Knowing, familiar with, R.i.92, M.iv.102.

ज्ञा vt. 9U (pp. ज्ञात; pres. जानाति, जानीते) 1. To know, to become acquainted with, ज्ञास्यसि कियुद्भुजो मे रक्षति मौर्वीकिणांक इति Sak.i.; 2. to apprehend, to understand, to experience; 3. to ascertain, to investigate, आपत्सु मित्रं जानीयात् Cāṇakya.; 4. to recognize, न त्वं दृष्ट्वा न पुनरलकां ज्ञास्यसे Megh.i.63; 5. to regard, to consider, to know as, तस्य मां तनयां सर्वे जानीत Bh.; 6. to be conversant or familiar with, to be aware of, नामधेयस्य ये केचिदभिवादंन जानते M.ii.123, जाने तपसो वीर्यम् Sak.ii.; 7. to act, to engage in, (with the gen. of the instrument, e.g. सर्पिषो जानीते ‘he engages in sacrifice with clarified butter’).With अनु-, 1. to permit, to allow, to assent to, M.iii.210; 2. to promise, मां जातमात्रां धनमित्रनाम्नेऽन्वजानाद्भार्यां मे पिता D.K.; 3. to acknowledge.With अप-, (in the Atm.) to conceal, आत्मानमपजानानः शशमात्रोऽनयद्दिनम् Bt.viii.26.With अभि-, 1. to know, to understand, to be acquainted with, Bg.xviii.55; 2. to regard, to consider, to know as; 3. to recognize.With अव-, to disregard, to neglect, अवजानंति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् Bg.ix.11, R.i.77, Bt.iii.8.With आ-, to know, to understand, to ascertain.With परि-, 1. to know, to be acquainted with, to be aware of, परिज्ञायते कतमेन दिग्विभागेन गतः स जाल्मः Vikr.i., M.viii.126; 2. to learn, to ascertain.With प्रति-, (in the Atm.) 1. to promise, प्रतिजज्ञे स्वयं चैव सुग्रीवो रक्षसां वधम् Bt.xiv.64; 2. to confirm.With वि-, 1. to know, to be aware of; 2. to understand, to learn, to ascertain; 3. to consider, to regard, to know as.With सम्-, (in the Atm.) 1. to recognize; 2. to agree together, to live in harmony (used with the acc. or inst., e.g. पित्रा पितरं वा संजानीते); 3. to know, to understand; 4. to watch for, Bt.viii.27; 5. (in the Par.) to think of, to remember, e.g. मातरं संजानाति or मातुः संजानाति.

ज्ञा Caus. (ज्ञापयति or ज्ञपयति) 1. to make known, to make acquainted with, to inform, to announce; 2. (in the Atm.) to request, to ask.With आ-, 1. to command, to order, to direct; 2. to give leave.With वि-, 1. to request, R.v.20; 2. to say, to speak, to communicate to.
ज्ञा Desid. (जिज्ञासते) to desire to know, R.ii.26, Bt.viii.33.
ज्ञंमन्य a. thinking oneself wise.
ज्ञपित a. (f. ता) Made known, informed, expounded.
ज्ञपित a. (f. ता) Made known, informed, expounded.
ज्ञापित a. (f. ता) Made known, informed.
ज्ञापित a. (f. ता) Made known, informed.
ज्ञप्ति f. 1. Understanding, intellect; 2. promulgating, making known.
ज्ञात a. (f. ता) Known, ascertained, understood, Sis.ii.12, (pp. of ज्ञा q.v.).
ज्ञात a. (f. ता) Known, ascertained, understood, Sis.ii.12, (pp. of ज्ञा q.v.).
ज्ञात-सिद्धांत m. a man completely versed in any Śāstra.
ज्ञाति m. 1. A father; 2. the agnatic relatives (collectively).
ज्ञाति-भाव m. relationship, kin.
ज्ञाति-भेद m. disunion among relatives.
ज्ञातेय n. Relationship.
ज्ञातृ m. 1. A wise man; 2. an acquaintance; 3. a bail, a surety.

ज्ञान n. 1. Knowing, understanding, knowledge, ज्ञाने मौनं क्षमा शक्तौ R.i.22, M.vii.211; 2. sacred knowledge derived from meditation which enables man to understand his own nature and to see the way to be reunited to the supreme spirit (as op. to कर्मन्), Bg.iii.3; 3. cognizance, consciousness; 4. the organ of intelligence, sense; 5. learning.
ज्ञान-अनुत्पाद m. ignorance, folly.
ज्ञान-आत्मन् a. all-wise.
ज्ञान-इंद्रिय n. an organ of perception, [of which there are five, viz., त्वच्, रसना, चक्षुस्, कर्ण and प्राण the skin, tongue, eye, ear and nose].
ज्ञान-कांड m. the esoteric portion of the Veda which treats of the knowledge of the supreme spirit, (op. to कर्मकांड).
ज्ञान-कृत a. done intentionally.
ज्ञान-गम्य a. attainable by the understanding.
ज्ञान-चक्षुस् (I) m. a learned and wise man.
ज्ञान-चक्षुस् (II) n. the mind’s eye, intellectual vision, (op. to चर्मचक्षुस्), सर्वं तु समवेक्ष्येदं निखिलं ज्ञानचक्षुसा M.ii.8, iv.24.
ज्ञान-तत्व n. true knowledge, i.e. knowledge of god.
ज्ञान-तपस् n. penance consisting in the cultivation of true knowledge.
ज्ञान-तस् ind. knowingly, intentionally.
ज्ञान-द m. a preceptor, a spiritual preceptor.
ज्ञान-दा f. an epithet of Sarasvatī.
ज्ञान-दुर्बल a. ignorant.
ज्ञान-निष्ठ a. engaged in the cultivation of true knowledge.
ज्ञान-मय (I) a. consisting of knowledge, spiritual, इतरो दहने स्वकर्मणां ववृते ज्ञानमयेन वह्निना R.viii.20.
ज्ञान-मय (II) m. an epithet of Śiva.
ज्ञान-यज्ञ m. a man conversant with true knowledge, one possessed of spiritual knowledge.
ज्ञान-योग m. contemplation as the means of attaining the supreme spirit.
ज्ञान-शास्त्र n. the science of fortune-telling.
ज्ञान-साधन n. 1. an organ of sense; 2. a means of acquiring true knowledge.
ज्ञानिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Intelligent, wise.
ज्ञानिन् (II) m. 1. An astrologer, a fortune-teller; 2. a sage, one possessed of spiritual knowledge.
ज्ञानिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Intelligent, wise.
ज्ञापक (I) a. (f. का) Making known, informing, indicating.
ज्ञापक (II) m. 1. A teacher; 2. a commander, a master.
ज्ञापक (III) n. A rule or precept implying something not expressly mentioned or laid down (in phil.).
ज्ञापक (I) a. (f. का) Making known, informing, indicating.
ज्ञापन n. Making known, announcing, informing, indicating.
ज्ञप्त a. (f. प्ता) Made known, informed, expounded.
ज्ञप्त a. (f. प्ता) Made known, informed, expounded.
